ModMetaData.name: Frostmite Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
Replaces sarg.alphaanimals' AA_Frostmite art (primary look, south/east/north facings only - the AA_FrostMite2/AA_FrostMite3 alternate looks and the dessicated-corpse texture stay on donor art) with custom generated art per the 2026-09-10 sitting ruling: propane-lake life should be utterly strange, not vanilla-Alpha-Animals-looking. LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/AA_FrostMite/AA_FrostMite_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
Donor ships this art as loose PNGs already (not AssetBundle-packed), so this is a plain file overwrite by load order - the loose-PNG-over-AssetBundle question ART_REGEN_WAVE1_WIRE_IN_1 answered doesn't even apply here.
